cases.name: normal
cases.dom:
- main:
  - heading "YNX Social attachment render check" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Engineering fixture only. Actual viewer and controller; public logo only. No Matrix server, wallet, account authorization, private file, cloud classifier or native installation.
  - button "Switch original fixture event"
  - button "Reject next open (fixture)"
  - status
  - heading "Encrypted attachment" [level=1]
  - button "Close attachment preview":
    - generic: Close
  - generic: Open the original attachment on this device. Closing removes the temporary preview; your original message is retained.
  - generic: Public original YNX logo.png
  - generic: image/png - 0.0 KB
  - generic "Original received image":
    - img "Original received image"
  - button "Retry original attachment":
    - generic: Retry original attachment
  - heading "Commit-time scope observations" [level=2]
  - generic: "[ { \"eventId\": \"$first\", \"layoutImagePresent\": false, \"layoutImageHTML\": null } ]"
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Current original event:"
    - code: $first
  - paragraph: "Released original fixture leases: 0"
